exposure: planned location of vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) (home vs. obstetric unit)
outcome: transfer rate from planned home birth
maternal outcomes (blood transfusion, admission to higher level care)
neonatal outcomes (stillbirth, Apgar score <7 at 5 minutes, neonatal unit admission)
cohort: 1436 women planning VBAC, including 209 planning home VBAC
finding: Women planning home VBAC had a higher chance of vaginal birth but also higher transfer rates, particularly for primiparous women, while adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes were similar between groups (around 2-3%).
